##### Project general facts

John Richmond Residences at Mira Coral Bay unveils itself as the world's first multi-branded waterfront community, an extraordinary destination where branded residences, five-star hospitality, and private beaches converge to create an unparalleled living experience. This visionary development, developed in partnership with Marjan, Ras Al Khaimah's master developer, offers a stunning collection of fully furnished homes that translate the bold aesthetic of British fashion legend John Richmond into a exquisite residential offering. With a selection of studios, one-bedroom, two-bedroom, and three-bedroom apartments and duplexes, every residence has been meticulously crafted to embody the pinnacle of waterfront luxury.

The John Richmond Residences are appointed with the finest details, featuring Italian-made furniture, premium appliances, exquisite lighting, luxurious linens, and complete kitchen equipment and tableware, ensuring that every home is move-in ready and exquisitely finished. Residents enjoy the highest standards of service with five-star hotel-level amenities that anticipate every need and desire, while the comprehensive Mira Care programme provides a five-year warranty on fixtures and a three-year warranty on furniture. This is a place where every detail has been considered, from the bold aesthetic of internationally renowned design to the practical comforts that make a house a home.

Beyond the extraordinary John Richmond Residences offers an unparalleled array of amenities that celebrate the waterfront lifestyle in all its glory. Residents enjoy private beach access, a prestigious yacht club, multiple swimming pools, five-star hotels, beach clubs, and an exquisite selection of restaurants, cafés, and retail destinations. The community also features a fitness and wellness centre, beautifully landscaped promenades, and dedicated family spaces, all designed to create a vibrant and enriching environment where life naturally moves towards the water.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Mairid in Ras Al Khaimah offers an idyllic coastal setting where the mountains meet the sea, creating a breathtaking backdrop for a lifestyle of unparalleled refinement and natural beauty. This enchanting location provides residents with direct access to pristine private beaches and the sparkling waters of the Arabian Gulf, offering a serene sanctuary that feels a world away from the everyday. The neighbourhood's unspoiled natural beauty and tranquil atmosphere make it the ideal destination for those seeking an escape from the ordinary and an embrace of the extraordinary.

Life within Al Mairid is defined by its exceptional balance of peaceful seclusion and convenient accessibility, with Downtown Ras Al Khaimah just minutes away and Al Marjan Island, home to the iconic Wynn resort, within easy reach. The surrounding area is rich with opportunities for exploration and leisure, from the world-class Al Hamra Golf Club to the vibrant cultural and commercial attractions of the emirate. This is a community where every day feels like a holiday, and where the gentle rhythm of the sea provides the soundtrack to a life of timeless elegance.

The surroundings of Al Mairid offer unparalleled access to the best that Ras Al Khaimah has to offer, with Ras Al Khaimah International Airport just a short journey away and Dubai within comfortable reach for those seeking the dynamic energy of the metropolis. The area's strategic location and excellent transport links make this coastal haven both accessible and exclusive, offering residents the perfect retreat without sacrificing convenience. This distinguished address truly offers the best of both worlds, combining the serenity of beachfront living with the dynamic allure of one of the region's fastest-growing destinations.
